question_text: Parcel defines tracking(), handling() anddelivery_note(). CooledParcel specializes temperature handling; VaccineParcel is a CooledParcel with a special delivery note. Explain how inheritance and method overriding avoid duplication while allowing calls through Parcel references.
adaptation_rationale: Same three-level reuse/override reasoning in a distinct delivery hierarchy; uses Python-compatible dynamic dispatch, notJavaoverloadassumptions.
solution: Place common tracking behaviour in Parcel.; CooledParcel inherits tracking and overrides handling for cooling requirements.; VaccineParcel inherits tracking and cooled handling.; VaccineParcel overrides delivery_note for its specific instructions.; Calls through the common interface dispatch to the actual object’s overriding methods, so shared code need not be duplicated.
